brief: Make elicify-vertex work end-to-end: multi-story goals, harness activation, and visible proof that system-prompt injection steers model behavior in real OpenCode chat.

stories.title: Prove injection is live
stories.objective: Document and demo that experimental.chat.system.transform injects <vertex-directives> (invisible in chat UI by design) and show operators how to verify via VERTEX_DEBUG / events; optionally surface a one-line user-visible cue if product wants it.

stories.title: Goals E2E in a project dir
stories.objective: create → next → work → verify → checkpoint → final receipt gate works under a writable project path; no /.elicify-vertex failures.

stories.title: Agent + slash UX
stories.objective: Agent multi_story_goals guidance and /elicify-vertex-goal-* templates produce correct tool calls without empty-args thrash.

stories.title: Stop/promise gates in live chat
stories.objective: Deep unverified edit blocks; docs-only and verified paths allow; promise-no-act fires on TODO-later after edits.

stories.title: Single plugin load hygiene
stories.objective: opencode.json loads one Vertex entry; dual-load and stale agent md eliminated on this host and documented for users.

stories.title: Final verification
stories.objective: Run the integrated exit proof and checkpoint its observed successful verification receipt.
